rubric_intent: Audit this preprint paper for epistemic accountability and hygiene, focusing on citation practices and transparency regarding evidence sources.

dimensions.name: README-Dominance
dimensions.description: Measures the degree to which the paper's claims rely heavily on README or documentation-style citations, indicating a potential lack of primary source evidence.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Count the number of citations classified as 'readme' or 'doc'. Assess if these citations disproportionately support core claims; if so, assess for potential lack of original data/code backing claims.

dimensions.name: Prose-as-Ground-Truth Justification
dimensions.description: Evaluates whether the paper explicitly and convincingly justifies its treatment of prose as a primary source of evidence, which is permissible under the preprint policy.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Search for explicit statements explaining why the prose itself constitutes evidence, and assess the quality of that justification. Look for explanations of how the prose is validated or derived.

dimensions.name: Source-Class Granularity
dimensions.description: Assesses the specificity with which the paper categorizes its evidence sources (e.g., 'code' vs. 'github repository' vs. specific file name).
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine citations to determine the level of detail provided about source type. More granular classification indicates greater accountability.

dimensions.name: Self-Marketing Cap Adherence
dimensions.description: Determines if the paper respects the self-marketing citation cap (typically 6) when all citations are 'doc' or 'readme', as a measure of avoiding superficial validation.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Count citations classified as 'doc' or 'readme'. If the count exceeds 6, assess whether the paper attempts to justify exceeding the cap (which is permissible, but requires justification).

dimensions.name: Code/Test Citation Presence
dimensions.description: Measures whether the paper cites code repositories or test suites as evidence for its claims, indicating a focus on reproducibility and verifiability.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Search for citations classified as 'code' or 'test'. The presence of these signals stronger accountability.

dimensions.name: Config Citation Presence
dimensions.description: Evaluates whether the paper cites configuration files used in experiments or system deployment, suggesting transparency regarding environment setup.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Search for citations classified as 'config'. Presence of config files implies more transparency about the environment.

dimensions.name: Other Source Justification
dimensions.description: Evaluates whether citations to sources classified as 'other' are justified or explained in terms of their relevance and reliability.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine citations classified as 'other' and assess whether the paper provides clear reasoning for their inclusion and value. hedge: true
